# Aditya Firmansyah

> Senior Software Engineer — Scalable Platforms & AI Workflows. 13+ years building scalable platforms, microservices, and autonomous multi-agent AI workflows. Practitioner notes, architecture war stories, and engineering benchmarks.

## Overview
- Website: https://aditf.com/
- Blog: https://aditf.com/blog/
- Consultation & Advisory: https://aditf.com/consult/
- RSS Feed: https://aditf.com/blog/rss.xml

- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/aditya-firmansyah-21940845
- Location: Surakarta, Central Java, Indonesia

## Core Competencies & Technical Stack
- AI & Autonomous Agents: Multi-agent orchestration, LLM tool-calling, Hermes Agent, Claude Code, evaluation harnesses, prompt workflows.
- Backend & Microservices: Python (FastAPI), Node.js (NestJS, Express), TypeScript, Rust, PostgreSQL, SQLite (WAL mode), Redis.
- Frontend & Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, static site generation, responsive UI/UX.
- Systems & Infrastructure: Linux homelab self-hosting, Docker, Caddy, Nginx, Git post-receive deploy hooks, systemd services, Cloudflare.
- E-Commerce & Domain Platforms: Multi-tenant SaaS, order orchestration, Indonesian QRIS payment flows.

## Flagship Projects
- [Dagango.com](https://dagango.com): High-performance multi-tenant e-commerce storefront platform built with Next.js and FastAPI.
- [mycv.ai.id](https://mycv.ai.id): Automated 8-stage AI resume and ATS optimization web application.
- [TirtaDesa](https://tirtadesa.com): Rural clean water utility management SaaS for Indonesian village communities.

## Field Notes & Technical Articles
Practitioner notes from production engineering, agent orchestration, and self-hosted infrastructure:

- [Agent Skills Are Environment Notes, Not Prompt Tricks](https://aditf.com/blog/agent-skills-environment-notes/): The "skills are worthless" argument is aimed at prompt folklore. What runs on a 19-profile agent fleet is closer to operational code, and it carries a real context bill. (Filed 26 Oct 2026, tags: ai-agents, skills, context-engineering, supply-chain, agent-fleet) (also available in [Indonesian](https://aditf.com/blog/agent-skills-environment-notes/id/))
- [The Distributed SQLite Paradox: You Pay for Consensus, Then Queue Behind One Writer](https://aditf.com/blog/distributed-sqlite-consensus-paradox/): Raft-replicated SQLite buys you failover and charges you milliseconds per write. Most production apps need WAL streaming to S3, not a cluster. (Filed 25 Oct 2026, tags: sqlite, distributed-systems, databases, devops, architecture) (also available in [Indonesian](https://aditf.com/blog/distributed-sqlite-consensus-paradox/id/))
- [Inside NVIDIA OpenShell: SMT Provers and Credential Proxies for Agent Fleets](https://aditf.com/blog/nvidia-openshell-agent-fleet-sandboxing/): OpenShell hides credentials behind a mediated proxy and gates policy changes with a Z3 solver. The sandbox is the easy half to copy. The per-sandbox model is the half that bites. (Filed 24 Oct 2026, tags: ai-agents, sandboxing, rust, security, devops) (also available in [Indonesian](https://aditf.com/blog/nvidia-openshell-agent-fleet-sandboxing/id/))

Your Env Vars Are Still the Wrong Vault.](https://aditf.com/blog/railway-breach-systemd-credentials/): Railway's October 2026 breach exposed decrypted environment variables from a secrets database.
